set.note: Optional AI translation through a service you choose: Claude, an OpenAI-compatible endpoint, or the Codex or Antigravity CLI.
CLI modes run the Codex or Antigravity CLI you installed; import and export touch only the files you pick.
AI assisted the code, tests, documentation and translations; the maintainer reviewed and tested the work and takes responsibility.

data_collected: Off by default; once enabled, the game text you choose to translate is sent to the service you selected.
Services: Google Translate (unofficial endpoint, also the optional fallback), Anthropic (Claude), an OpenAI-compatible service, or the Codex or Antigravity CLI.
The text is not anonymized and may include player names or private messages.
Nothing is sent to the mod author.
